name: Grate
overview: The Scriptures provide detailed instructions concerning the construction of a brass grate for the altar, emphasizing its precise design and placement beneath the altar's compass to the midpoint (Exodus 27:4-5; 38:4-5). This grate, made of a network of brass with four rings at its corners, served a practical function in the tabernacle's sacrificial system, supporting the altar and facilitating the handling of offerings. These passages highlight the care and intentionality God prescribed for worship, reflecting the holiness and order He requires in approaching Him.
